newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hospital Pantai to buy medical centre.
newsitem.headline: Hospital Pantai to buy medical centre.

text.p: Malaysian hospital operator Hospital Pantai Bhd has proposed to acquire 87.88 percent of Merjiwa Medical Associates Sdn Bhd, which operates a medical centre in central Selangor state, for 7.47 million ringgit.

Hospital Pantai said in a statement on Tuesday that the vendors of the stake would guarantee a pre-tax profit of one million ringgit annually for the first three financial years after acquisition under the terms of the agreement.
The acquisition, to be financed from internal funds and bank borrowings, would contribute positively to Hospital Pantai and provide synergy with its existing healthcare business, it said.
